tools.title: Portable Genlib skill and MCP setup
tools.summary: Generate native host configuration, safely install the shared skill and verify local MCP calls for OpenClaw, Hermes, Antigravity, VS Code, Cursor, OpenCode, Claude, Codex and other hosts. Ollama runs through an MCP host.

tools.title: Task-scoped code context
tools.summary: Ranks at most five files, related import edges and likely tests for a task from the commit-bound repository map and AST graph, so an agent reads only selected source.

tools.title: Repository map and impact
tools.summary: Commit-bound index of tracked paths, symbols, imports and hashes with symbol search and import-impact queries; fails closed when stale.

tools.title: AST dependency graph
tools.summary: TypeScript/JavaScript AST import graph with a content-hash parse cache and transitive dependency impact; preferred over the heuristic graph when present.

tools.title: Repository diagram
tools.summary: Mermaid overview of directory groups and resolved cross-group imports, generated locally from the fresh map and graph; never uploads source.

tools.title: Exact-version dependency health
tools.summary: Inventory locked package versions offline; explicitly enrich selected versions through cached deps.dev, OSV and lifecycle metadata with unknown/error states preserved.

tools.title: Retrieval and context evaluation
tools.summary: Evaluate realistic application reuse queries, policy exclusions, bounded Jev packets and serialized context sizes without claiming model-token savings.

notes: These tools index the repository they run in. Run them inside Genlib, or copy them into another repository after review. Graphify-style semantic graphs are an optional Genisys adapter boundary, not bundled here.
